title: Why Not Just Leave China?
titleZh: 为什么不干脆离开中国？
description: After a former language partner moves to Shenzhen, Steven thinks about where he would go if he ever left Beijing, and walks through the practical realities of long-term life in China: whether a Chinese degree is worth it, Class A vs. B work visas, spouse visas, the Chinese green card, and an economist's advice to stay out of stocks. He also complains about QR-code office hours and answers people who ask why he doesn't just leave.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 今天是周一，史蒂文心情有点感慨，也有点坐不住。
sentences.en: It's Monday, and Steven is feeling a bit nostalgic, and a bit restless too.

sentences.zh: 一位以前的语言伙伴搬去了深圳，让他不禁想：要是哪天离开北京，自己会去哪儿？
sentences.en: A former language partner moved to Shenzhen, which got him wondering: if he ever left Beijing, where would he go?

sentences.zh: 接着，他聊到在中国生活的“硬核现实”：中文学位值不值钱，A类、B类签证有什么区别，配偶签证和中国绿卡怎么回事，还有一位经济学家劝他远离股市。
sentences.en: Next, he talks about the "hard realities" of living in China: whether a Chinese degree is worth anything, the difference between A and B category visas, how spousal visas and Chinese green cards work, and an economist who advised him to stay away from the stock market.

sentences.zh: 最后，他吐槽了扫二维码打卡的坐班时间，也回应了那些总问“你为什么不干脆离开”的人。
sentences.en: Finally, he vents about office hours where you clock in by scanning a QR code, and responds to the people who keep asking "Why don't you just leave?"

sentences.zh: 老朋友南下深圳
sentences.en: An old friend heads south to Shenzhen

sentences.zh: 史蒂文以前的一位语言伙伴升了职，搬到深圳，还找了新男友。
sentences.en: One of Steven's former language partners got a promotion, moved to Shenzhen, and found a new boyfriend.

sentences.zh: 她说深圳更绿，但没有北京那么有历史味儿。
sentences.en: She says Shenzhen is greener, but it doesn't have as much of a sense of history as Beijing.

sentences.zh: 这让他浮想联翩：深圳离香港和广州都近；而从北京出发，附近只有朝鲜、韩国，以及飞三个小时就到的日本，不过那儿“贵得要命”。
sentences.en: This set his mind wandering: Shenzhen is close to both Hong Kong and Guangzhou, while from Beijing the only places nearby are North Korea, South Korea, and Japan, just a three-hour flight away, but it's "insanely expensive" there.

sentences.zh: 可问题还在：“不在北京，不在中国，那去哪儿？”
sentences.en: But the question remains: "If not Beijing, and not China, then where?"

sentences.zh: 新雇主问他会待多久，他指指自己的中国女朋友：“她把我留在了这儿。”
sentences.en: His new employer asked how long he would stay, and he pointed to his Chinese girlfriend: "She's the one who's kept me here."

sentences.zh: 同事请他推荐北京周边的好去处，他在这座城市住了十二年，回答却是：“我就待在家里，没了。”
sentences.en: A coworker asked him to recommend good places to visit around Beijing, and although he's lived in the city for twelve years, his answer was: "I just stay at home. That's it."

sentences.zh: 读中国历史的同事
sentences.en: The colleague who studied Chinese history

sentences.zh: 新来的同事是个个子很高的英国小伙子，1999年出生，中文相当出色：
sentences.en: The new colleague is a very tall young Englishman, born in 1999, whose Chinese is quite outstanding:

sentences.zh: 通过了HSK六级。
sentences.en: He passed HSK Level 6.

sentences.zh: 在英国读了中国历史本科，又在台湾读了同专业的硕士，还拿到了奖学金。
sentences.en: He did a bachelor's degree in Chinese history in the UK, then a master's in the same field in Taiwan, and he even got a scholarship.

sentences.zh: 他现在在大学里旁听马克思主义、中国历史和书法课。
sentences.en: He is now auditing classes in Marxism, Chinese history and calligraphy at the university.

sentences.zh: 连人事都承认，这些课上的学生不是在打游戏，就是在刷微信。
sentences.en: Even HR admits that the students in these classes are either playing games or scrolling WeChat.

sentences.zh: 所以史蒂文不让用电脑、逼学生开口说话的课堂，才会让他们大吃一惊。
sentences.en: That's why Steven's classes, where computers aren't allowed and students are pushed to speak, take them completely by surprise.

sentences.zh: 同事开玩笑说，想旁听，“只要证明你是中国的朋友就行”。
sentences.en: The colleague joked that if you want to audit, "you just have to prove you're a friend of China."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文回敬：“你没看到我YouTube频道最近的评论吗？”
sentences.en: Steven shot back: "Haven't you seen the recent comments on my YouTube channel?"

sentences.zh: 他家里也有一本《毛主席语录》。
sentences.en: He also has a copy of "Quotations from Chairman Mao" at home.

sentences.zh: 读过吗？
sentences.en: Has he read it?

sentences.zh: “没有，但我有。”
sentences.en: "No, but I have."

sentences.zh: 中文学位有什么用？
sentences.en: What's the use of a Chinese degree?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文问人事，中文学位到底有什么用。
sentences.en: Steven asked HR what use a Chinese degree really is.

sentences.zh: 她说：能为签证加分。
sentences.en: She said: it can earn points for a visa.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文持有的是B类Z字（工作）签证。
sentences.en: Steven holds a Category B Z (work) visa.

sentences.zh: B类就是“普通人”，A类则按学历、中文水平和“特殊人才”来打分。
sentences.en: Category B means "ordinary people," while Category A is scored by education, Chinese level, and "special talent."

sentences.zh: 最大的区别是年龄：北京不给60岁以上的人办工作签证，而A类可以到70岁。
sentences.en: The biggest difference is age: Beijing doesn't issue work visas to people over 60, while Category A allows up to 70.

sentences.zh: “然后呢？”
sentences.en: "And then what?"

sentences.zh: 话题就这么“不了了之”。
sentences.en: And so the topic just "fizzled out."

sentences.zh: 他十二年没违过法，有HSK四级和五级证书。
sentences.en: He hasn't broken the law in twelve years, and has HSK Level 4 and Level 5 certificates.

sentences.zh: 读个学位要两到四年，那时他都快五十了。
sentences.en: A degree takes two to four years, by which time he'd be nearly fifty.

sentences.zh: 能给英语老师涨工资吗？
sentences.en: Would it get an English teacher a raise?

sentences.zh: “大概不会。”
sentences.en: "Probably not."

sentences.zh: 配偶签证与中国绿卡
sentences.en: Spousal Visas and the Chinese Green Card

sentences.zh: 配偶签证不能工作，也不能同时持有两种签证。
sentences.en: A spousal visa doesn't let you work, and you can't hold two visas at the same time.

sentences.zh: 丢了工作签证，公安会给你30天的人道主义签证，这期间可以申请最长两年的配偶签证。
sentences.en: If you lose your work visa, the police give you a 30-day humanitarian visa, and during that time you can apply for a spousal visa of up to two years.

sentences.zh: “看，这里多重视家庭纽带。”
sentences.en: "See how much they value family ties here."

sentences.zh: 中国永久居留证要五年，持有人能做中国人能做的任何工作，只是没有投票权：“去问问中国人上次是怎么投的吧。”
sentences.en: Chinese permanent residence takes five years; holders can do any job a Chinese citizen can, they just can't vote: "Go ask Chinese people how they voted last time."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文认识的持卡人，要么在2020年前是高额纳税人，要么是娶了中国人的长期居民。
sentences.en: The card holders Steven knows were either high taxpayers before 2020 or long-term residents who married a Chinese person.

sentences.zh: “离股市远一点”
sentences.en: "Stay away from the stock market"

sentences.zh: 人事的父亲是经济学博士，他的建议是：别碰股票，把积蓄存在银行。
sentences.en: Renshi's father has a PhD in economics, and his advice is: don't touch stocks, keep your savings in the bank.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说“这建议不坏”，想起这些年自己给中国股市交的那些“有趣的学费”。
sentences.en: Steven says "that's not bad advice," recalling all the "interesting tuition" he has paid to the Chinese stock market over the years.

sentences.zh: 不过他不同意：
sentences.en: But he disagrees:

sentences.zh: 加拿大、美国和英国有ETF和税优账户，把钱放进去就能不用管；中国没有同样的东西。
sentences.en: Canada, the US and the UK have ETFs and tax-advantaged accounts, so you can put your money in and not have to manage it; China has nothing like that.

sentences.zh: 外国人只能买A股，不能买H股，也不能做期权。
sentences.en: Foreigners can only buy A-shares, not H-shares, and they can't trade options either.

sentences.zh: 这不算投资建议：“钱是你的，麻烦是你的，责任也是你的。”
sentences.en: This isn't investment advice: "It's your money, your hassle, and your responsibility."

sentences.zh: 读金融，开公司，拿绿卡？
sentences.en: Study finance, start a company, get a green card?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文把这些线索串了起来：如果他用中文在中国大学读金融呢？
sentences.en: Steven connected the dots: what if he studied finance in Chinese at a Chinese university?

sentences.zh: 既能提高中文，又能拿A类加分，还能开一家咨询公司，为自己担保签证，朝绿卡努力。
sentences.en: He could improve his Chinese, earn Category A bonus points, and also open a consulting company to sponsor his own visa and work toward a green card.

sentences.zh: 数学怎么办？
sentences.en: What about math?

sentences.zh: “这不就是AI的用处吗？一直用到考试前。”
sentences.en: "Isn't that exactly what AI is for? Use it right up until the exam."

sentences.zh: 可接着疑虑来了：他没有替别人管钱的业绩，而且到那时他“多半已经结婚生子了。所以，史蒂夫，哪条路更容易？”
sentences.en: But then the doubts set in: he has no track record managing other people's money, and by then he'd "most likely be married with kids. So, Steve, which path is easier?"

sentences.zh: ⏰ 院长会议与坐班时间
sentences.en: ⏰ The Dean Meeting and Office Hours

sentences.zh: 史蒂文七点半离开健身房时，人事提醒他十点四十五有场与院长的会议，他早忘了。
sentences.en: As Steven left the gym at 7:30, HR reminded him that he had a meeting with the dean at 10:45, which he had completely forgotten.

sentences.zh: 他在会上提出了对坐班时间的担忧：
sentences.en: At the meeting he raised his concerns about office hours:

sentences.zh: 学生通过扫二维码签到，他每周平均得坐班六小时。
sentences.en: Students check in by scanning a QR code, and he has to average six office hours a week.

sentences.zh: 可时段只有六个，所以“只要一个学生缺席，平均就不可能是六小时”。
sentences.en: But there are only six time slots, so "if even one student is absent, the average can't possibly be six hours."

sentences.zh: 再加上备课，他一周大约工作22小时。
sentences.en: Add lesson prep, and he works about 22 hours a week.

sentences.zh: 院长说可以看看措辞，他也不指望有什么改变。
sentences.en: The dean said they could look at the wording, but he doesn't expect anything to change.

sentences.zh: 那位讨人喜欢的年轻同事先进去了，“然后轮到留着二十英寸大白胡子的我来谈坐班：你们给得太少了。”
sentences.en: The likable young colleague went in first, "and then it was my turn, with my twenty-inch white beard, to talk about office hours: you're paying us too little."

sentences.zh: “你为什么不干脆离开中国？”
sentences.en: "Why don't you just leave China?"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文希望这期节目能回答那些“你为什么不……”
sentences.en: Steven hopes this episode can answer those "Why don't you..."

sentences.zh: 的问题：开学校、换工作、离开中国。
sentences.en: questions: opening a school, changing jobs, leaving China.

sentences.zh: “没那么容易。”
sentences.en: "It's not that easy."

sentences.zh: 他的女朋友一辈子都在中国，不太想走。
sentences.en: His girlfriend has lived in China her whole life and doesn't really want to leave.

sentences.zh: 对老家那些把离开说得轻飘飘的人，他想反问：“你们为什么没离开家乡？”
sentences.en: To the people back home who talk about leaving as if it were nothing, he'd like to ask in return: "Why didn't you leave your hometown?"

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 对长期在华的外国人来说，留下来取决于签证分数、年龄限制、合同和人际关系，而不只是喜不喜欢这个地方。
sentences.en: For foreigners who have lived in China long-term, staying depends on visa points, age limits, contracts and personal connections, not just on whether they like the place.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文用幽默的态度权衡着各种选择，而对“你会去哪儿”的回答依然是：“到了那座桥再过那座桥。”
sentences.en: Steven weighs the various options with a sense of humor, and his answer to "Where will you go?" is still: "I'll cross that bridge when I come to it."

vocab.en: thoughts coming one after another; to daydream
hard-core reality; the tough practical side of things
to sit in on a class as a non-registered listener
to leave a matter unresolved; to let it fizzle out
to add points; to give an advantage
to be on duty at the office during set hours
light and casual; making something sound easy
